# Hypothesis Context: H-E1
# JIT-generated by Phase 2C step-01 from 02b_verification_plan.md

## Hypothesis Information

**ID:** H-E1
**Type:** EXISTENCE
**Gate:** MUST_WORK
**Status:** IN_PROGRESS
**Prerequisites:** None

**Statement:**
Under GPT-4o-mini generation on HumanEval+ and MBPP+ (temperature=0.8, single shot),
if we run mypy (permissive mode) on all initial generated solutions, then a non-trivial
fraction (≥10%) of failing solutions will have mypy-detectable type errors, because
type mismatches are a common failure mode in LLM-generated Python code.

**Rationale:**
Foundational existence check. If type errors are rare (<5%), mypy signal is too sparse
to improve repair and the entire main hypothesis becomes moot. Establishing the base
rate is a prerequisite for all mechanism hypotheses.

## Experimental Setup (from Phase 2A via Phase 2B)

### Dataset Selection

| Field | Value |

| Hypothesis Fit | MBPP+ (378 problems) provides sufficient statistical power; HumanEval+ (164) serves as replication. EvalPlus augmentation reduces false positives in pass@1 measurement. |

### Model Selection

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | GPT-4o-mini |
| Type | API-based LLM (OpenAI) |
| Source | OpenAI API |
| Hypothesis Fit | Strong Python understanding; affordable for ~7,400 generation calls; temperature=0.8 for initial generation (single shot). |

## Variables

- **Independent:** None (observational study)
- **Dependent:** Fraction of failing solutions with ≥1 mypy error
- **Controlled:** GPT-4o-mini, temperature=0.8, 3 seeds, full benchmark problem sets

## Success Criteria

- **Primary:** ≥10% of failing solutions have ≥1 mypy error on MBPP+
- **Secondary:** ≥10% on HumanEval+

## Failure Response

- IF rate < 5%: PIVOT — mypy signal too sparse; reconsider hypothesis scope
- IF 5-10%: EXPLORE — continue with reduced expectation of effect size

## Baseline Methods

| Method | Performance | Dataset |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| No-repair baseline | ~55-60% pass@1 (estimated) | HumanEval+ |
| Self-Debug (execution-only) | ~65-70% pass@1 with k=3 | HumanEval/MBPP |
| Reflexion (verbal feedback) | ~67% pass@1 with k=3 | HumanEval |

## Key Assumptions

| ID | Assumption | If Violated |
|----|------------|-------------|
| A1 | Type errors ≥20% of HumanEval+/MBPP+ failures under GPT-4o-mini | If <5%, mypy adds negligible signal |
| A2 | GPT-4o-mini can incorporate mypy errors to improve repair | LLM cannot parse mypy output |
| A3 | mypy in permissive mode has low false-positive rate | High FP adds noise |
